company.description:
WBTC bridging to Hedera has resumed.

@SaucerSwapLabs Labs confirmed that BitGo has restored DVN verification, allowing users to once again bridge WBTC to @hedera via  LayerZero. 

This is not just a technical update.

It is an infrastructure signal. 

SaucerSwap is the leading DEX in the Hedera ecosystem.

It enables users to swap, provide liquidity, stake, and access DeFi on Hedera with fast finality and predictable low fees.

So when WBTC bridging resumes, it matters for Hedera DeFi.

WBTC brings Bitcoin liquidity into DeFi.

For @HederaFndn that means more potential liquidity, more trading routes, more utility, and a stronger foundation for BTC-related DeFi activity inside the ecosystem.

Liquidity is the bloodstream of DeFi.

The key name here is @BitGo 

BitGo is not a random bridge operator.

It is a Hedera Council member and helps shape enterprise adoption of the Hedera network.  

BitGo also plays a major role in institutional digital asset custody.

On December 12, 2025, the OCC announced conditional approvals for five national trust bank charter applications, including BitGo Trust Company’s conversion.  

BitGo states that BitGo Bank & Trust, N.A. is authorized to offer custody and fiduciary services under the national bank charter, subject to applicable law and OCC requirements.  

That matters.
Because custody, trust, and compliance are not side quests for institutional adoption.

They are the gate.

The temporary pause was about verification and security.

SaucerSwap stated at the time that user funds, including pending transactions, remained secure while WBTC transfers via LayerZero were paused.  

Now verification has been restored.

This is how serious infrastructure behaves.

Not move fast and hope.

More like, verify, secure, resume.

For institutional-grade DeFi, that is exactly the kind of discipline the market should want to see.

@LayerZero_Core adds the interoperability layer.

BitGo selected LayerZero’s OFT Standard for WBTC, enabling WBTC to exist across multiple blockchain networks.  

Hedera now sits inside that broader cross-chain liquidity map.

So the bigger picture is simple:

Bitcoin liquidity.
Hedera DeFi.
SaucerSwap as the leading DEX.
LayerZero interoperability.
BitGo custody and verification.
OCC-regulated trust infrastructure.

That combination is worth paying attention to.

Many people will only see, 
WBTC bridging resumed.

But underneath that headline sits something much bigger:

Hedera DeFi is being connected to institutional-grade Bitcoin infrastructure.

company.description:
Had a really wonderful evening in @glider_fi's Discord server. @BrianInCrypto the co-founder and CEO was the main speaker in the session.

Brian is an MIT alumnus, he has been active in crypto since 2014 and previously worked as a Product Manager at Anchorage Digital and as a high volume trader at XTX Markets, where he managed flows exceeding $20 billion per day. With deep experience bridging traditional finance and blockchain.

Here are the main points he talked about in the session:

Glider’s New Lending Feature:

Brian introduced Glider’s brand new Lending feature, one of the most exciting additions to the ecosystem so far. Users can supply idle assets into lending pools and earn yield directly within the platform, eliminating the need to move funds elsewhere for passive returns.

Perplexity Finance:

Brian also introduced Perplexity Finance and shared how AI-powered analytics can help users make smarter financial decisions. This adds an intelligence layer giving users stronger research tools alongside execution.

Traditional Markets Meet On Chain Finance:

He analyzed live charts for the S&P 500, oil prices, and company revenues showing how macroeconomic signals can connect directly with opportunities inside Glider’s ecosystem.

Stock Insights:

Companies like Eli Lilly and Palantir were highlighted as examples of firms with strong relevance in current market discussions, giving users a broader lens on financial opportunities.

Roadmap Alpha:

At the end of the session, Brian shared some important updates about the future.

He said that incentivized campaigns will start soon, staking will be introduced, a new blockchain is being built, and perpetual trading (perps) is also coming in the future.

What I learned:

The Lending feature is very important because it allows users to earn passive income from assets that are not being used. This helps improve capital efficiency, which many platforms still lack.

Second, using AI tools like Perplexity Finance along with live market and company data gives users better research power. It helps them make smarter decisions.

Third, the future plans like staking, new chain, perps, and campaigns show that the team is building for the long term and focusing on the community.

It was a really great session overall. I would like to see more sessions like this in the future where he will be talking.😍
